quote1.text: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
quote1.author: Edgar Degas

quote2.text: Every artist was first an amateur.
quote2.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote3.text: Museums are places where we can explore our past and imagine our future.
quote3.author: Thomas Campbell

quote4.text: A work of art is the unique result of a unique temperament.
quote4.author: Oscar Wilde

quote5.text: The purpose of art is washing the dust of daily life off our souls.
quote5.author: Pablo Picasso

quote6.text: Culture is the widening of the mind and of the spirit.
quote6.author: Jawaharlal Nehru
